title: 12U open frame vs 10-inch wall cabinet
summary: Closet lab needs a place for a switch and UPS, not a 42U. 19-inch 12U is the default.

start.body: A closet lab needs a place to hang a switch and a UPS, not a 42U. The 19-inch 12U 2-post is the default because almost everything you already own is 19-inch.

choices.label: I want a door on 19-inch gear

19.body: Default: StarTech 2POSTRACK12 — 12U 19-inch 2-post, 350 lb. Street was about $156 this pass. Put the metal strip and UPS on the same frame. Tie leads with hook-and-loop.

10.body: NavePoint 6U 10-inch wall cabinet looks quieter and smaller — but 10-inch switches are a specialty buy. Only if you already own that gear. Not the default.

cabinet.body: StarTech RK12WALHM — 12U 19-inch wall cabinet with a door. Recheck the live price. Still 19-inch.

skip.body: Skip a full-size 42U. Skip RGB rack accents. Skip the 10-inch cabinet unless you are buying 10-inch networking on purpose.
